import { Component, Input, Output, EventEmitter } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { SharedModule } from '@/app/shared/shared.module'; import { ConversationMessage } from '@/app/core/models'; @Component({ selector: 'app-todo-message-card', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule, SharedModule], template: `
{{ message.sender }} {{ getTextContent(message.content) }} {{ message.timestamp }}
` }) export class TodoMessageCardComponent { @Input() message!: ConversationMessage; @Output() onViewInChat = new EventEmitter(); @Output() onUnmarkTodo = new EventEmitter(); getTextContent(html: string): string { return html.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ''); } }
